question: Prediction of MCI-to-AD conversion within 3 years among ADNI MCI participants. The shared channel is structural MRI: P-186 is multimodal (neuropsychological measures plus FreeSurfer MRI markers), and Bae et al. use raw baseline T1 MRI only. The ledger's AUC 0.827 for P-174 is Bae et al. (the P-37 document). The PDF mapped to P-174 is a MEG paper (Xu et al., Madrid cohort) that reports no AUC 0.827, and P-174's block is a stub duplicate of P-171, itself a duplicate of P-37. The comparison is therefore P-186 vs Bae et al. (P-37). Allowed differences: input (longitudinal feature trajectories with a forecast value vs one baseline image), features, label definition, sample size and validation.

figures.P-186: NM+MRI, 1-year-ahead: AUC 0.957, n=85 (35 MCIp, 50 MCIs), 5-fold CV. Hanley-McNeil with n1=35, n2=50: SE 0.0249, 95% CI 0.908-1.000. MRI-only (the shared channel), 1-year-ahead: AUC 0.905 (Table 5), SE 0.0366, 95% CI 0.833-0.977. MRI-only, 6-month-ahead (n=119, 49/70, same 36-month conversion label): AUC 0.88, SE 0.0344, 95% CI 0.813-0.947.
figures.P-37: Bae et al.: test-set AUC 0.827, accuracy 82.4%, on 68 independent held-out scans, one baseline scan per subject. The paper gives 37 MCI-C with conversion in 0-3 years for the test evaluation, implying 31 MCI-NC. Hanley-McNeil with n1=37, n2=31: Q1=0.7050, Q2=0.7487, SE 0.0498, 95% CI 0.729-0.925. A balanced 34/34 split gives SE 0.0507, CI 0.728-0.926.
figures.P-174: The PDF mapped to P-174 (Xu et al., MEG, 76 MCI: 28 pMCI/48 sMCI) reports mean accuracy of 78% for sMCI vs pMCI and no AUC 0.827; its dataset (Madrid clinic), channel (MEG) and metric differ from P-186's.
figures.comparison: Headline figures: the intervals do not overlap (0.908-1.000 vs 0.729-0.925); each estimate lies outside the other's interval.

matched_figure_check: P-186 reports results in the channel Bae et al. use (MRI only), with the same 36-month conversion label; neither is a single-scan result. At 1 year ahead, P-186's MRI-only 0.905 lies inside Bae's interval (0.729-0.925). Bae's 0.827 lies 0.006 below the Hanley-McNeil lower bound for 0.905 (0.833), a margin smaller than the precision of that approximation for a cross-validated estimate with a post-hoc marker-subset size. At 6 months ahead, P-186's MRI-only 0.88 (CI 0.813-0.947) and Bae's 0.827 (CI 0.729-0.925) agree in both directions. The channel-matched figures therefore sit at the edge of agreement: one agrees fully, the other fails the rule's test by 0.006 in one direction. Whether they reconcile the pair (a condition-3 failure) is the open judgment.
performance_validity: Passes condition 5 on the compared figures: 0.957 and 0.827 are below 0.97. P-186's ground-truth AUC of 0.98 uses observed future values and is not the compared figure. P-186's figures are optimistic: features are scaled before the train-test split and the best marker-subset size is reported.

candidate_explanations.difference: Predictor set: P-186's 0.957 adds neuropsychological measures to MRI. Its own MRI-only figures (0.905, 0.88) come close to Bae's MRI-only 0.827, so most of the headline gap follows the added cognitive channel.
candidate_explanations.quote: the classiﬁcation power of our system is the highest when NM measures are used in conjunction with MRI measures

candidate_explanations.difference: Input representation: longitudinal marker trajectories with a forecast value at the time of conversion (P-186) vs one baseline raw scan (Bae et al.).
candidate_explanations.quote: Included in the target task is the single time point sMRI scan at which an individual ﬁrst received a diagnosis of MCI.

candidate_explanations.difference: Label definition: Bae's non-converters must remain MCI for at least 3 years; P-186's stables are those retaining MCI through the 36-month follow-up in an ADNI-1 subsample with complete consecutive visits.
candidate_explanations.quote: This resulted in 228 MCI-C patients and 222 MCI-NC patients.

candidate_explanations.difference: Validation: one independent held-out test of 68 scans (Bae) vs 5-fold CV with pre-split scaling and a post-hoc marker-subset size (P-186).
candidate_explanations.quote: We scale all features to have values between 0 and 1 before the train-test split.

reason: Read against the right document (Bae et al., P-37), the pair shares the question, the MRI channel and the metric, and the headline AUCs (0.957 vs 0.827) are separated beyond uncertainty. But P-186's own MRI-only figures, the channel Bae uses, nearly close the gap: at 6 months ahead (0.88) they agree with Bae's 0.827 in both directions, and at 1 year ahead (0.905) Bae's figure misses the derived interval by 0.006. Whether these channel-matched figures reconcile the pair is a knife-edge call. If reported, the ledger pair must be repointed from P-174 to P-37.
